limitations: Windows, Core 0.2.1-rc.3 / NEXT 2.0.20-next / Cordis 4.0.5 exact compatibility only; private APIs need upgrade regression
Unknown historical resource ownership cannot be reconstructed reliably: rc11 explicitly retains all workspace files and attachments for that plan, including permanent deletion
Selected-session corruption, active/pending work, foreign ownership, stale registry and unresolved transactions can still block deletion
Fresh rc11 A/B/C restart/restore and historical native UI cases; earlier race, locale, pin/archive and recovery-fault matrices are retained by original evidence version
Isolated NEXT uses original runtime and extracted app source; Office and packaged directory-transition launcher are outside acceptance
All writers sharing a root must participate; arbitrary external writers, unknown plugin stores and unmapped image variants are not fully coordinated
Old terminal payload cleanup remains explicit; no automatic real-history scrub or real user deletion was performed
